notes: THE STUB BOOK · Fey Faire's half of the StickLoop contract.
EARN: ticket stubs for a finished summer — nights spent + feys
recruited + half the gold you walk out with. CARRY: FeyFaireHost
reads effects/flags at start_new_run; the midway reads booth and
provision flags live. ≥1 FLAG per tier per the playbook.

currency.name: TICKET STUBS
currency.earn_line: a finished summer pays stubs · nights spent + feys recruited + half your leaving gold

upgrades.name: A HEAVIER PURSE
upgrades.blurb: you arrive with three more gold. the gate does not ask where it came from, which is itself information.

upgrades.name: THE PRESSED ROSE
upgrades.blurb: a rose from a summer that has already happened, flat in wax paper. it rides in as a keepsake — and the feys can smell which summer.

upgrades.name: A THERMOS OF STRONG TEA
upgrades.blurb: one free provision's worth of warmth per summer, no gold down. the Faire's food rules do not apply to what you carried in.

upgrades.name: MARGIN NOTES
upgrades.blurb: your own hand, from summers you half-remember, in the midway map's margins. deep cells stop pretending to be new.

upgrades.name: THE STRING OF STUBS
upgrades.blurb: every ride you have ever taken, on one string. booth games pay one extra gold — the barkers respect a regular.

upgrades.name: MORGAN'S BOOKMARK
upgrades.blurb: she left it in a book you bought. carrying it, the fortune tent reads you on night one without being found first — the reading comes to YOU.
